title: CROWN: a new marble-look porcelain stoneware collection
excerpt: The CROWN brand presents a new collection that reproduces classic marble texture in a warm palette. Formats 600×600 and 600×1200, polished and matt finishes.
body:
CROWN is the DADO brand devoted to classic Italian elegance. The new collection continues this direction: soft veins typical of natural marble, gentle tonal transitions and a warm, muted shade.

The collection is produced in two core formats, 600×600 and 600×1200. The smaller format suits bathrooms and corridors, while the large format creates a seamless, ceremonial surface in living rooms and public spaces.

Each colour is offered in two finishes. The polished surface reflects light and makes a room feel larger. The matt surface looks calmer and is better suited to floors.

For designers, the collection includes matching shades for walls and floors. This makes it possible to finish one space in a single style but with different textures.

Samples of the collection are available in our Tashkent showroom. For orders and advice, write to info@dadoceramics.uz or call +998 78 150 00 02.
